title: Mlai entry domain train val test split
topic: Mlai entry domain train val test split
question: Why do you need three separate splits (train, validation, test) instead of just training and testing on the same data or using a single train/test split?
idealAnswer:
Training data is used to fit model parameters; evaluating on that same data gives an overly optimistic estimate because the model has already seen it

A validation set is used to tune hyperparameters and make model selection decisions without touching the test set, so those choices don't leak into the final performance estimate

The test set is held out entirely until the very end and used only once, to give an honest estimate of performance on truly unseen data

If you tune hyperparameters using the test set, you're indirectly fitting to it, and reported performance will overestimate real-world performance

A typical split might be around 60/20/20 or 70/15/15, though exact proportions depend on dataset size, and cross-validation can substitute for a fixed validation split
